_notes: rd_animation__small_sprites is 32x32 only and outputs a sheet containing:
4-direction walking + arm movement + looking + surprised + laying down.
Each call costs ~0.07 USD. Re-runs skipped unless --force.
Prompts force chibi proportions (oversized head, small body) for the Habbo look.
